Key Features & Specifications:


Sensor & Performance: Up to 3600 DPI (adjustable 1200-1800-2400-3600). It offers 20G acceleration and a 1000Hz report rate for responsive gaming.Design: Ergonomic, ambidextrous shape suitable for extended use.Lighting: Chroma RGB lighting.Buttons: 6-7 programmable macro buttons.Cable Length: Approximately 1.3 meters.Compatibility: Windows and other operating systems via USB 2.0.
